summary.title: Analysis Methodologies and Tools - Yasin's Publications
summary.one_liner: A publication and talk index by Ahmad Yasin covering Top-Down Microarchitecture Analysis (TMA) and related CPU performance-counter research, with links to papers, slides, and the perf-tools software package.
keywords: reading list for cpu performance engineering
takeaways: The Top-Down Method (TMA) splits pipeline slots into front end, bad speculation, back end and retiring categories, the tree that profilers report.
Yasin's 2014 ISPASS paper and related talks describe how TMA works and how to use it to tune applications.
Related papers cover Skylake and Alder Lake microarchitecture, OLTP analysis, and energy-efficiency metrics.
The page links to the perf-tools GitHub package (aayasin/perf-tools) for automating performance analysis.
summary.summary: This is a personal publications page listing papers, talks, a PhD thesis, and software by Ahmad Yasin, organized by decade. Entries are grouped under 2020s, 2010s, professional talks, and motivating talks, each with a short citation and links to slides, papers, or recordings. The most relevant entries for performance work are the Top-Down Microarchitecture Analysis papers (ISPASS 2014, Intel whitepaper 2013) and the TMA lecture and slide decks. The page itself contains only listings and links rather than explanatory content, so the details must be read in the linked sources.
technologies: Intel microarchitectures (Skylake, Alder Lake, Ice Lake)
